sections.indications:
Dull complexion 
 Hyper-pigmentation 
 Pimple 
 Blemishes

 Kumkumadi Anti-ageing Thailam 


 Buy Now 

 Directions for Use 
 Take just 3 -5 drops of the oil into your hands, apply a light coat of it evenly onto the face or to the acne area. Do a gentle massage with your fingers. Leave it for 10 – 20 minutes. Wash off with hot water.
sections.side_effects:
There are no side effects of this oil but for people with oily skin it should use in small quantities. 
 It is better to test this oil over a small skin area before starting using it. If you develop any rash / burning / itching sensation, avoid using it. Arya Vaidya Sala Kumkumadi Anti-Ageing Thailam caused such rash in one of my clients, who used it for dark circles. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Kumkumadi Anti-Ageing Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Astanga Hridayam, Bhaishajya Ratnavali – 60/115-120 
 Introduction 
 Kumkumadi Anti-Ageing Thailam is Ayurvedic herbal oil preparation used for face massage. It is helpful to improve skin texture, complexion and also to relieve skin problems such as acne, scars etc. Kumkuma, which is the main ingredient of this taila, kumkuma means saffron. It is also known as Kumkumadi Thailam, Kumkumadi Taila, Kumkumadi tail. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kumkum – Crocus sativus – 1 part 
 Patranga – Caesalpinia sappan – 1 part 
 Ushira – Vetiveria zizanioides – 1 part 
 Manjistha – Rubia cordifolia – 1 part 
 Padmak – Prunus puddum – 1 part 
 Kamal – Nelumbo speciosum – 1 part 
 Laksha – Laccifer lacca – 1 part 
 Daruhaldi – Berberis aristata – 1 part 
 Nagkesar – Mesua ferrea – 1 part 
 Kusum Phool – Carthamus tinctorius – 1 part 
 Riyangu – Callicarpa macrophylla – 1 part 
 Vatankur – Ficus benghalensis – 1 part 
 Madhu Malti – Hiptage madablota – 1 part 
 Bee Wax – Cera alba – 1 part 
 Sarshapa – Brassica juncea – 1 part 
 Rasna – Pluchea lanceolata – 1 part 
 Payas – Pueraria tuberosa – 1 part 
 Dashmoola – Roots of 10 herbs – 1 part 
 Til Oil – Sesamum indicum – 4 parts 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Boil First set of herbs (except saffron) upto Dashamoola roots in water and Kashayam (decoction) is prepared and then filtered. 
 Sesame oil and herb powders From Manjishta to Yastimadhu, along with goat milk are added to above prepared decoction. Boil in mild fire till the Thailam is prepared. 
 Indications 
 
 Dull complexion 
 Hyper-pigmentation 
 Pimple 
 Blemishes 
 Wrinkled skin 
 Scars 
 
 
 Kumkumadi Anti-ageing Thailam 
 
 
 Buy Now 
 
 Directions for Use 
 Take just 3 -5 drops of the oil into your hands, apply a light coat of it evenly onto the face or to the acne area. Do a gentle massage with your fingers. Leave it for 10 – 20 minutes. Wash off with hot water. 
 Side Effects 
 There are no side effects of this oil but for people with oily skin it should use in small quantities. 
 It is better to test this oil over a small skin area before starting using it. If you develop any rash / burning / itching sensation, avoid using it. Arya Vaidya Sala Kumkumadi Anti-Ageing Thailam caused such rash in one of my clients, who used it for dark circles. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
